module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter shifting valid serial bits into an 8-bit shift register under a bit counter, then emitting the byte with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit shifted into din_tmp.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid; gates counter advance and shifting.

anchors.name: din_tmp
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register accumulating serial bits MSB first.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter; gates shifting and triggers output when equal to 8.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Parallel byte output loaded from din_tmp at count 8.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse accompanying dout_parallel when cnt reaches 8.

groups.name: shift_in
groups.description: Shift register collecting valid serial bits.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: Counts received bits and marks the output cycle.

groups.name: output_reg
groups.description: Registers the parallel byte and valid pulse.
